1,870 likes, 23 comments - sanjeevkapoor on October 6, 2026: "Bhindi ki chipchipahat se pareshaan? 👀

Bas ek simple trick: bhindi ko dhone ke baad poori tarah sukhaayein, pakate waqt dhakkan na lagaayein, aur end mein amchur, kokum ya nimbu ka ras add karein. 👩‍🍳✨

Thodi si technique, aur bhindi banegi less slimy, more delicious!

Save this hack for your next bhindi recipe. 💚

#SanjeevKapoor #CookingHacks #Bhindi #IndianCooking #KitchenTips
